name: Cargo Manifest
//: Story Phase 15: the Skunk Weed is story cargo (lots, story variable skunk_weed_lots), not an item you use. Fictional. Bargain-bin. Mostly stems.
description: CARGO: SKUNK WEED (FICTIONAL). {num:skunk_weed_lots} lots, in Pete's hand. Grade: stems, mostly. Origin: 20,000 Grand Tokens and seven real doubloons.

variants.description: SKUNK WEED (FICTIONAL). {num:skunk_weed_lots} lots: the EMERGENCY MELLOWING SUPPLY. Captain's authority only (committees, sash panics). Grown-ups only.

name: Modern Cash
//: Story Phase 15: the visitors' money. A story oddity: it is not gold and no shop on this ship (or in this century) takes it.
description: {num:modern_cash} 'dollars', in green paper, from the visitors. Not gold. Not anything. Pete says it's money, somewhere. Squawks says: bad money. You keep it in your boot anyway.

name: Relief Teller's Badge
description: THE BASHFULNESS BRANCH. RELIEF GRAND TELLER. Pinned on you by a teller made of haze on his way to his tea break. The pin is bent the other way from the last one.

variants.description: RELIEF GRAND TELLER. Customer rating: 2.3 / 5. CUSTOMERS FOUND TELLER HOSTILE. The branch is gone. The rating stayed.

name: Loan Fee Receipt
description: SASH-BACKED LOAN, GRAND LADY WHIFFLEBOTTOM: 47 SILVER. STATUS: CANCELLED (COLLATERAL DESTROYED). FEES: NONREFUNDABLE. Stamped, with feeling, by you.

name: Agnes's Feather
description: A brown feather, caught on the rail where Agnes the Second was last seen, going round with the Sharkstorm. Brogath asked you to keep it. You said you would.
